variability.method: later epoch log-flux interpolated in wavelength at the earlier epoch's points (gap <= 1.5 bandwidths); dmag > 0 = fading; errors scaled by sqrt(chi2_red)

field_star_shifts.method: 15-sigma peaks in full-epoch co-adds (target track excluded), 2-D Gaussian centroids, matched within 1 px; median shift of each epoch relative to the last full epoch (grid is north-up)

criteria.name: detected at S/N >= 10 in D5+D6 co-adds of each main DR1 epoch
criteria.threshold: co-add aperture S/N (r = 2 px, noise from random apertures) >= 10 in every full DR1 epoch

criteria.name: not detected in D1-D4 (main DR1 epochs)
criteria.threshold: |co-add aperture S/N| < 5 for D1, D2, D3, D4 and D1-D4 stacks (forced IVW S/N listed second)
criteria.notes: the r = 2 px aperture contains the catalogued W1 = 15.0 / W2 = 15.2 neighbour (4-11 arcsec away), which is bright in D1-D4

criteria.name: detected at S/N >= 10 in D5+D6 co-adds of each main DR1 epoch [PSF photometry, neighbour modelled]
criteria.threshold: bootstrap S/N of the forced PSF flux >= 10 in every full DR1 epoch

criteria.name: not detected in D1-D4 (main DR1 epochs) [PSF photometry, neighbour modelled]
criteria.threshold: |bootstrap S/N of the forced PSF flux| < 5 for D1-D4
